previews: Static frames rendered from source SWFs; split mount layers composed at their original coordinates. Transparent margins cropped.
ornaments: Individual SWFs retain original linkage and all required character dependencies.
mount_validation: Original SWFs are byte-identical to the client. Every exported walk/run symbol was inspected with FFDec, recursively including nested character timelines; all have more than one frame. 7000 (static only), 9097 (no run) and map objects were excluded.
